title: OpenAI Previews 'Operator' Autonomous Web Agent: End-to-End Browser Task Execution
summary: OpenAI officially previewed Operator, an autonomous computer-using agent capable of executing complex multi-step workflows, research, and web navigation across standard web browsers.
content:
OpenAI has previewed 'Operator', a specialized autonomous agent system capable of interacting directly with modern web interfaces, filling forms, booking itineraries, and running end-to-end digital workflows on behalf of human users.

### Moving from Text Suggestions to Autonomous Execution
While generative conversational models assist with advice and code snippets, Operator represents the agentic shift into direct action. Powered by advanced vision-language multi-modal models, Operator observes browser DOM structures, coordinates mouse clicks, enters dynamic form fields, solves interactive filters, and verifies execution steps.

### Key Capabilities Highlighted in Early Previews:
• **Multi-Tab Research & Cross-Referencing**: Simultaneously extracts structured tables and pricing comparisons across competing vendors.
• **Booking & Transaction Orchestration**: Confirms seat maps, inputs loyalty credentials, and pauses at checkout for human financial authorization.
• **Error Recovery & Visual Correction**: Intelligently retries when dropdown menus fail or dynamic modals intercept navigation.
• **Safety & Human-in-the-Loop Constraints**: Strict safety bounds preventing unauthorized payment submissions or irreversible state changes.

OpenAI plans to roll out developer preview access to enterprise partners and ChatGPT Pro users before opening API integration.
